_metadata.description: The same wizard on every deployment tier: local repository, desktop bundle, and remote host reached through vrooli-bridge or scenario-to-cloud.

requirements.title: While the wizard runs on any supported deployment tier, every step shall resolve its data and no step shall return an error.
requirements.description: Compositional claim for the tier domain. The desktop bundle now carries the complete manifest-derived catalog and the browser-validated wizard resolves every declared step without an error.

validation.notes: Evidence: boots the API with only the bundle root set and exercises every V2 endpoint.

requirements.title: While the wizard runs from a desktop bundle, it shall resolve every manifest it reads from the bundled catalog.
requirements.description: The desktop runtime deliberately does not set a repository root, because a standalone app has no monorepo. Every manifest class the wizard reads — scenarios, resources, tools, safeguards — must therefore be present in the bundle catalog.

validation.notes: Evidence: host requirements resolve from a bundle fixture containing tool and safeguard manifests.

requirements.title: If a manifest source is unavailable on the running tier, then the step shall present a named actionable state and shall not return an unhandled error.
requirements.description: A directory-read failure currently becomes a server error and the step renders a generic failure line. The target distinguishes 'this tier does not carry that catalog' from 'this host is broken', because the two have different operator responses.

validation.notes: Evidence: an absent catalog yields a typed degraded response, not a 500.

requirements.title: If a desktop bundle omits a catalog path the wizard reads, then the bundle build check shall fail.
requirements.description: The bundle contract declares the catalog paths onboarding depends on, and the packaging step verifies them. This turns a silent runtime failure on an operator's machine into a build failure on ours.

validation.notes: The onboarding bundle fixture exercises the catalog read models and the desktop runtime catalog contract separately fails closed when a declared catalog path is missing.
Recorded BAS bundle-tier evidence proves the BUNDLE_ROOT-only browser walk and HTTP-200 V2 endpoint sweep.

requirements.title: The operator-state location shall be resolved from the deployment tier, and a desktop install shall not write the repository document.
requirements.description: A bundle resolves its state under the app data root supplied by the desktop runtime; a repository install resolves the repository document. A desktop app and a local install on one machine are separate installs by design.

validation.notes: Asserts the storage-root fallback resolves outside the repository when no repository root is set.

requirements.title: vrooli-bridge should configure a remote host through the non-interactive surface with no hand-edited file.
requirements.description: Bridge owns reaching the machine and holding the connection through the canonical `vrooli-bridge onboard connect --host <host> --user <user>` workflow; onboarding owns deciding what runs there. The identity-only handoff joins the two authorities without exposing operator-state internals. First touch may consume one SSH password, while reconnect reuses durable Bridge trust without prompting; real remote apply remains deployment evidence to be earned.

validation.notes: Evidence target: `scenarios/vrooli-bridge/api/internal/onboarding/client_test.go`; this requirement remains planned until a real remote target is available. The focused Bridge client tests cover capability-shaped selection transfer and authoritative readiness handling, but do not substitute for a real VPS run.

requirements.title: The union export should determine which scenarios, resources, tools, and safeguards a remote or bundled target must carry.
requirements.description: Shipping the whole repository to every target does not scale, and hand-maintained per-target lists drift. One computation, consumed by every target, keeps them consistent by construction.

validation.notes: Evidence target: `api/v2_union_test.go`; this requirement remains planned until that evidence is added. the union for a two-scenario selection excludes unrelated catalog members.
